findings.claim: walkCorpus's manifest-skip compares a corpus-root-relative path ('VENDOR.json') against the cwd-relative manifest path ('tools/harness/VENDOR.json') — never equal in the documented layout — so bare host mode refuses EVERY honest vendored tree at the WIRING §1 location, and the manifest cannot declare itself (self-digest has no fixed point); the docstring 'The manifest's own path is skipped' is dead code
findings.proof: A vendor following WIRING §1 verbatim (manifest at tools/harness/VENDOR.json, correct digests) runs the documented bare invocation and is refused forever; both escape routes (self-declare → permanent 'patched'; delete → fail-closed missing-manifest) dead-end, so adopters abandon the gate, reopening the silent-drift gap it exists to close; every shipped guard is blind because the self-test injects corpusFiles and the battery's only live entry is --upstream

findings.proof: An agent in the host commits a born-scoped manifest: every run is green while the actual vendored harness is patched without limit — the §1 promise 'manifest is law' holds vacuously because the client chose what the law can see; nothing in the change ever compares vendored/files/upstream against actual stallion state
